usedFor: Freshsales Suite holds contacts and Stripe holds billing customers, so “Contact Created” can run “Create Customer”.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Created” in Freshsales Suite, then “Create Customer” in Stripe
bestTemplate.why: Each new contact is ready to bill in Stripe, and “Create Customer” updates an existing customer instead of duplicating.

watchOut: “Contact Created” in Freshsales Suite is polling, so the Stripe customer appears after a scheduled check.
